BiblicalUsage: Meror is the bitter herb eaten at the Passover. Exodus 12:8 commands the lamb to be eaten roast with fire, with unleavened bread, and with bitter herbs, and Lamentations 3:15 has the prophet say God filled him with bitterness and made him drunken with wormwood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bitter herb belongs on the Passover table on purpose: freedom tastes of bitterness remembered.
